lines.reason_short: Cracked windscreen needs the camera-bracket glass for this Model 3.

lines.reason_short: Autopilot camera needs calibrating after the windscreen is replaced.
lines.reason_long: The Autopilot camera sits on the windscreen, so it must be recalibrated after the glass is changed. This depends on the windscreen being confirmed.

result.reply: I suggested the windscreen with camera bracket and the Autopilot camera calibration for this Model 3.
